character.description: Ordo, nonhumanoid spirit embodied as a maintained safety gate. Tall wide arch of two thick deep indigo glazed ceramic pillars connected by curved beam. Center OPEN, background visible through it. Wooden outer braces, thin brass indicator plates on inner sides. Horizontal amber skylight in center of beam. One wooden barrier arm horizontally spans opening, visibly hinged in brass at screen-right pillar inner side. No face, eyes, mouth, limbs, crown, robot, scenery or text. Entire gate connected. Nearly frontal view.
